method: Every token the scored vaults hold or lend against, rated on five dimensions from sourced research (backing 30%, redemption and exit 20%, peg and price stability 20%, control 15%, track record 15%; anchors 95 to 10, 40 = unknown). Live signals (peg, price gaps, volatility, exit depth) can only lower a rating. unrated = no research entry yet.
disclaimer: Research and information, not investment advice.
